newsitem.title: USA: Global Games buys Intl Gaming Resorts.
newsitem.headline: Global Games buys Intl Gaming Resorts.

text.p: Global Games Corp said Tuesday it acquired International Gaming Resorts Inc through a private placement with a Global Games subsidiary.
The net effect will result in an infusion of cash and other assets totaling $3.5 million.
"The proceeds will enable us to begin operations of our virtual reality casino on the Internet by February 1997, from our headquarters in the Caribbean," said chairman Garry Jamieson.
"The casino that is in development will offer computer users around the world the chance to play poker, blackjack, Bingo, Sportsbook and slot machines with real money at stake," Jamieson added.
The company said one analyst has predicted that onpline betting could be a $10 billion a year industry by 2000.
